label: At most one minimal object
definition: For a supplied Type B and PartialOrder B, every two IsMin objects are equal: forall x y, IsMin x implies IsMin y implies x=y. IsMin is Mathlib minimality, equivalent here to no strict proper part. This asserts at most one, not existence; a nonempty atomless carrier can satisfy it vacuously. It is the exact content unrestricted proper-part extensionality adds to the composite-restricted principle, not a restatement of either principle or of their implication.
note: Analyst mathematical strength comparison for #336 review repair. Uses the same supplied carrier and PartialOrder; no actuality, necessity, existence of a minimal object or metaphysical simplicity. See docs/dependence-shapes.md, Strength-fork repair.
